title: Silver Recycling Market Growth
narration: This chart illustrates the significant growth in the global silver recycling market, driven by increasing e-waste and growing awareness of sustainability. The market was valued at $1.78 billion in 2023 and is projected to grow at a CAGR of 4.7% through 2028.  A key driver is the substantial 20% of global silver supply recovered from industrial processes, with the average spot price having increased by 15% over the past five years.
